A predominantly white canvas is interrupted by an intricate explosion of abstract mechanical forms concentrated slightly right of center. Large translucent circular arcs resemble fragments of gears or architectural blueprints, overlapping with fine black lines that radiate in every direction like technical drawings pulled apart. Dense clouds of charcoal gray and black ink gather through the center, fading into wisps of translucent smoke that drift downward and to the left. Scattered crimson and warm amber highlights emerge from within the darker mass, creating the impression of heat or energy buried beneath layers of fractured geometry. Thin sweeping curves loop gracefully around the composition, contrasting with sharp angular shards and delicate splatters of ink. Near the lower left, a ribbon of smoky black fluid curls outward before dissolving into soft transparent haze. The composition leaves generous negative space around the central structure, emphasizing both movement and isolation while blending architectural precision with expressive, organic motion.
